net.guizhanss.fastmachines.libs.guizhanlib.slimefun.items.builder

Class RecipeBuilder

  • java.lang.Object
    • net.guizhanss.fastmachines.libs.guizhanlib.slimefun.items.builder.RecipeBuilder

  • public class RecipeBuilder
extends java.lang.Object
    A small builder for describing a 3x3 shaped recipe as three 3-character rows (row(java.lang.String)) plus a mapping from each character to an ingredient (where(char, io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.libraries.xseries.XMaterial)). A blank space always means "no ingredient". Java-8-safe port of GuizhanLib-kt's buildRecipe DSL.
